programme.desc: Now that Greg Focker is "in" with his soon-to-be in-laws, Jack and Dina Byrnes, it looks like smooth sailing for him and his fiancée, Pam. The hyper-relaxed Fockers and the tightly-wound Byrneses are woefully mismatched from the start, and no matter how hard Greg and Pam try, there is just no bringing their families together. programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Mutated graboids return to feast on the residents of Perfection, threatening its new status as a tourist attraction.","large":"Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: An alien that can duplicate other life forms invades a polar research station in this remake of the 1951 classic "The Thing from Another World."","large":"In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: An acid-scarred scientist (Liam Neeson) uses 99-minute masks to be with his girlfriend (Frances McDormand) and trap gangsters.","large":"When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: George Lucas' tale of an extraterrestrial duck who is mistakenly brought to Cleveland by an experimental laser beam.","large":"In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: A suburban homeowner's vacation with his wife becomes a horror after some odd neighbors move in next door.","large":"Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: An irresponsible playboy becomes emotionally attached to a woman's12-year-old son. The man and child help each other in an unlikely friendship.","large":"A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: A nursing-home resident (Jessica Tandy) regales a visitor (Kathy Bates) with tales of the close friendship between two women in the 1930s Alabama.","large":"On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: A middle-class man (Steve Martin), his wife (Mary Steenburgen), his father and a divorcee (Dianne Wiest) try to be good parents.","large":"Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: An architect (Steve Martin) has a girlfriend (Dana Delany) who won't move into his house and a dizzy woman (Goldie Hawn) who won't move out.","large":"Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: A police detective (James Belushi) with a girlfriend (Mel Harris) gets stuck with a new partner, a German shepherd dog.","large":"Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression, a doctor, once a psychiatric patient, uses humor and unconventional methods in his practice.","large":"After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: An aspiring filmmaker (Winona Ryder) follows the paths of her friends after they graduate from college in Texas.","large":"After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After spending time in a remote village to atone for his past, a martial artist (Jet Li) gets caught in a duel to defend China's honor against his country's enemies.","large":"After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: A scam artist (Terrence Howard) introduces a young man (Channing Tatum) to New York's bare-knuckle street-fighting circuit.","large":"Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld.","large":"A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: A deranged suitor (Mark Wahlberg) torments family and friends of a teen girl (Reese Witherspoon) with whom he is obsessed.","large":"When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: A woman (Kate Hudson) takes a job as a hospice nurse for a couple (Gena Rowlands, John Hurt) who live in a New Orleans house with a troublesome history.","large":"Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: A woman and her 9-year-old twin sons encounter the evil spirit of Bughuul in a rural house that's marked for death.","large":"Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: Drag Me to Hell
programme.desc: Christine Brown has a good job, a great boyfriend, and a bright future. But in three days, she's going to hell.","large":"Christine Brown has a loving boyfriend and a good job at a Los Angeles bank. Her heavenly life becomes hellish when, in an effort to impress her boss, she denies an old woman's request for an extension on her home loan. In retaliation, the crone places a curse on Christine, threatening her soul with eternal damnation. Christine seeks a psychic's help to break the curse, but the price to save her soul may be more than she can pay.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: After their daughter is assaulted and left for dead, a couple (Tony Goldwyn, Monica Potter) take revenge on the assailants, who have taken shelter at the couple's house.","large":"Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge, is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach.","large":"A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: A woman and her 9-year-old twin sons encounter the evil spirit of Bughuul in a rural house that's marked for death.","large":"Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: After their daughter is assaulted and left for dead, a couple (Tony Goldwyn, Monica Potter) take revenge on the assailants, who have taken shelter at the couple's house.","large":"Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: Quasifederal agents hunt a man (David Keith), who can bend minds, and his daughter (Drew Barrymore), who can start fires by staring.","large":"As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop.".

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: A deranged suitor (Mark Wahlberg) torments family and friends of a teen girl (Reese Witherspoon) with whom he is obsessed.","large":"When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Hired to find a missing person in New Orleans, a merchant seaman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) becomes the prey of those (Lance Henriksen, Arnold Vosloo) who hunt men for sport.","large":"Chance Boudreaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sailor skilled in martial arts, is employed to guard Natasha Binder (Yancy Butler) as she tracks down her father, an itinerant Vietnam veteran living in New Orleans named Douglas (Chuck Pfarrer). They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

programme.title: Hard Target 2
programme.desc: A retired mixed martial artist (Scott Adkins) is offered one final bout, but he learns he has been tricked into becoming the target of a human hunt when he arrives for the fight.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: Sold into the underworld of gambling and kickboxing, a street criminal (Jean-Claude Van Damme) vies with the world's best fighters in an ancient Tibetan competition.","large":"In the slums of New York City during the 1920s, petty thief Chris Dubois (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds himself on the run from the police. At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After spending time in a remote village to atone for his past, a martial artist (Jet Li) gets caught in a duel to defend China's honor against his country's enemies.","large":"After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: A scam artist (Terrence Howard) introduces a young man (Channing Tatum) to New York's bare-knuckle street-fighting circuit.","large":"Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: The Kingdom
programme.desc: A sympathetic Saudi police captain helps a team of federal agents flush out a terrorist cell in Riyadh.","large":"Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: A cop must arm prisoners to help fend off an attack by gunmen who want to kill a gangster locked away in the crumbling station.","large":"While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.desc: Four women take their book club to Italy for the fun girls' trip they never had. When things go off the rails and secrets are revealed, their relaxing vacation turns into a once-in-a-lifetime, cross-country adventure.

programme.title: The Darkness
programme.desc: A supernatural force terrorizes a couple (Kevin Bacon, Radha Mitchell) and their two children after the young son brings home some mysterious rocks from the Grand Canyon.","large":"Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: Dead in the Water
programme.desc: An all-female crew, on a boat in the middle of nowhere, must deal with an invader on their ship.

programme.title: Dead Man's Eyes

programme.title: Delirium

programme.title: Dementia 13
programme.desc: A mysterious masked killer terrorizes members of a family at a secluded estate.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: While investigating the disappearance of her twin sister, a young American encounters the tormented spirits of Japan's mysterious and legendary Aokigahara Forest.","large":"When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Games
programme.desc: A mysterious woman (Simone Signoret) in black moves in with married Manhattan thrill-seekers (James Caan, Katharine Ross) and helps one trick the other.","large":"Wealthy and bored, Paul (James Caan) and Jennifer Montgomery (Katharine Ross) while away their hours in a New York City apartment filled with pinball machines and other amusements. The couple's routine is upended when door-to-door saleswoman Lisa Schindler (Simone Signoret) drops by and is suddenly taken ill. The Montgomerys let her spend the night. And soon, the sophisticated Lisa and her hosts embark on a new set of very adult -- and very dangerous -- games.

programme.title: Gone
programme.desc: A televangelist (Gregory Itzin) influences a confrontational man (Billy Burke) motivated by revenge.

programme.title: The Green Inferno
programme.desc: Student activists (Lorenza Izzo, Ariel Levy) crash-land in the Amazon and encounter an indigenous tribe of cannibals who'd like to have them for dinner.","large":"New York college student Justine (Lorenza Izzo), a lawyer's daughter, meets a student activist named Alejandro (Ariel Levy) when he goes on a hunger strike on behalf of underpaid janitors. Smitten, Justine agrees to help Alejandro undertake his next project: to save the Amazon. She soon learns to regret her decision when their plane crashes in the Peruvian jungle and she and the rest of their group are taken captive by a tribe of hungry cannibals.

programme.title: The Guardian
programme.desc: Yuppies (Dwier Brown, Carey Lowell) with a baby hire a nanny (Jenny Seagrove), a druid witch who sacrifices babies to a tree.","large":"Optimistic about their future, well-off parents Kate (Carey Lowell) and Phil (Dwier Brown) hire the pleasant and lovely young Camilla (Jenny Seagrove) to live with them and care for their new baby. Though Camilla seems like an answer to their prayers, she proves to be more than she appears, and a diabolical plot involving the wellbeing of their child is uncovered. The young parents are forced to fight supernatural forces for the life of their vulnerable offspring.

programme.title: I Saw What You Did
programme.desc: Two teenage girls, bored while baby-sitting, make prank phone calls, completely unaware one of the people on the other end of the line has just killed his wife and now thinks the girls must be silenced.","large":"Kit (Sarah Lane) and her best friend, Libby (Andi Garrett), are two teenage girls bored while baby-sitting. To pass the time, they make prank phone calls, telling the person on the other end of the line, "I saw what you did, and I know who you are!" It's all in good fun, until they call a man (John Ireland) who just murdered his wife and buried her in the woods. Convinced they actually do know his secret, he becomes determined to find out who they are and silence them forever.

programme.title: Incarnate
programme.desc: Recruited by a Vatican emissary (Catalina Sandino Moreno), an exorcist (Aaron Eckhart) taps into the subconscious mind of a tormented boy (David Mazouz) to free him from demonic possession.","large":"After a single mother witnesses terrifying symptoms of demonic possession in her 11-year-old son (David Mazouz), a Vatican representative calls on wheelchair-bound scientist Dr. Seth Ember (Aaron Eckhart) to rid him of the evil spirit. Driven by a personal agenda rooted in his own tragic past, Ember enters the boy's unconscious mind where he confronts a demon as ferocious as it is ingenious.

programme.title: The Keeping Hours
programme.desc: A lawyer sees the ghost of his dead son, which leads the man's estranged wife back into his life.

programme.title: Killer High
programme.desc: Sabrina's perfectly planned high school reunion goes south when a monster keeps killing all the guests.

programme.title: Boogeyman
programme.desc: Mike (Eddie McClintock), the town sheriff, has to battle the mythical Boogeyman after boys accidentally release it.

programme.title: Long Time Dead
programme.desc: A genie terrorizes London students (Lara Belmont, Melanie Gutteridge) after they unwittingly summon it with a Ouija.","large":"After a long night of dancing and drinking their way into a haze, roommates Rob (Joe Absolom), Liam (Alec Newman), Stella (Lara Belmont) and Spencer (James Hillier) and a few of their friends duck into a back room of the nightclub to play around with a Ouija board. None of the friends like what the board tells them: they will all die that night. Sure enough, one by one the young friends are slaughtered by a malevolent killer, amid revelations about satanic worship and sacrifice.

programme.title: The New Daughter
programme.desc: A single father (Kevin Costner) is puzzled by his daughter's (Ivana Baquero) weird behavior, which begins soon after he moves his family to a secluded woodland home.

programme.title: Nightmare
programme.desc: A guardian (David Knight) and his lover (Moira Redmond) stage grim scenes to drive a haunted English heiress (Jennie Linden) mad.

programme.title: Not Safe for Work
programme.desc: An office worker becomes trapped in a building with a killer.

programme.title: Phantasm II
programme.desc: Two psychically linked teens (James LeGros, Paula Irvine) cannot escape from the grave-robbing Tall Man of their nightmares.","large":"Years after surviving his encounter with the sinister Tall Man (Angus Scrimm), Mike Pearson (James LeGros), now a mental patient, still has nightmares about the evil gaunt mortician. Upon being released from the institution, Mike and his friend Reggie (Reggie Bannister) set out to track down the Tall Man and end his murderous and macabre practices. Also involved is Liz Reynolds (Paula Irvine), a pretty young woman who has a psychic connection to both Mike and the Tall Man.

programme.title: Rosewood Lane
programme.desc: Sonny Blake (Rose McGowan), a radio talk show therapist, moves back to her childhood home after her father dies. She is shocked to learn her neighbors are terrified of the paperboy (Daniel Ross Owens) who turns out to be a dangerous sociopath.

programme.title: Saint Ange
programme.desc: Strange events haunt a pregnant woman (Virginie Ledoyen) and others at a recently vacated orphanage in the French Alps.","large":"Anna is a cleaning woman who accepts a post at the St. Ange Orphanage. She arrives to confront an unsettling lack of orphans, save for one who acts far too childish for her age. Then the bizarre sights and sounds begin, which seem to elude detection by the only other servant or the gloomy institution's director. Is this all in Anna's mind? Or does something more sinister lurk in the heart of St. Ange?

programme.title: Session 9
programme.desc: Asbestos removal crews start work in an abandoned insane asylum, and strange happenings begin to occur.","large":"A tale of terror when a group of asbestos removal workers start work in an abandoned insane asylum. The complex of buildings looms up out of the woods like a dormant beast. Grand, imposing, abandoned, deteriorating. The residents of Danvers, Massachusetts, steer well clear of the place. But Danvers State Mental Hospital, closed down for 15 years, is about to receive five new visitors.

programme.title: SiREN
programme.desc: A man visits a supernatural nightclub during his bachelor party and inadvertently crosses paths with a dancer who is actually a terrifying, legendary creature.","large":"One week before his wedding day, Jonah and his groomsmen hit the town for a wild night of club hopping and debauchery. The night soon takes a twisted turn for the worse when the group is invited to a seedy underground club. After Jonah frees a seemingly imprisoned dancer, he realizes that the woman he released is actually a terrifying, legendary creature that will stop at nothing to claim her prey.

programme.title: The Skulls
programme.desc: A freshman (Joshua Jackson) joins an elite society that will guarantee him success, but he questions his decision when his reporter roommate dies mysteriously.","large":"For Luke McNamara (Joshua Jackson), an invitation to join the prestigious secret college organization, The Skulls, is a dream come true. But he soon comes to realize just how powerful The Skulls organization really is -- and that the truth, like success, comes at a very high price.

programme.title: The Skulls II
programme.desc: A new inductee (Robin Dunne) into the secret society witnesses a murder at the hands of one of its members.","large":"The Skulls, a secret college society whose influence reaches the highest levels of government and business, recruit Ryan Sommers (Robin Dunne), whose future success now seems all but assured. Then one day he sees one of his fraternity brothers kill a young woman -- a crime that Ryan must keep secret if he is to remain a Skull. While Kelly (Lindy Booth), a good friend, pushes him to follow his conscience, Ryan's girlfriend, Ali (Ashley Lyn Cafagna), surprises him by being against his snitching.

programme.title: The Skulls III
programme.desc: A young woman (Clare Kramer) gets more than she bargained for when she gains entrance to a males-only secret society.","large":"In this sequel, beautiful and determined college student Taylor Brooks (Clare Kramer) is intent on joining the secret society known as the Skulls, despite its history of being an organization consisting solely of men. Although she encounters strong resistance, Taylor takes steps toward being accepted into their ranks, but her efforts are derailed when her boyfriend is found dead. Taylor is considered the prime suspect. Can she clear her name and track down the real murderer?

programme.title: The Spider Woman Strikes Back
programme.desc: She (Gale Sondergaard) and her hulking servant grow bloodsucking plants, as a young woman (Brenda Joyce) finds out.

programme.title: Stephanie
programme.desc: After a mysterious global catastrophe, a young girl is left alone to hide from a malevolent power that stalks her home.","large":"A young girl is left alone in her house during a worldwide catastrophe and fearfully hides from a malevolent force that is stalking her. When her parents miraculously return, they try to settle back into normal life, but become increasingly concerned about something that has affected their daughter Stephanie.

programme.title: Virus
programme.desc: Passengers (Jamie Lee Curtis, William Baldwin, Donald Sutherland) on a sinking ship board a seemingly deserted Russian vessel containing a mutating alien force.","large":"Caught in a typhoon, a tugboat commanded by Robert Everton (Donald Sutherland) comes across a mysterious near-deserted ship. Excited to find a vessel that could be sold for as much as $30 million, Everton and his crew board and prepare to move the craft, despite the warnings of sole survivor Nadia Vinogradova (Joanna Pacula). programme.desc: Rusty and riddled with bullet holes, Bill's neighbor hands over the crumbling shell of a '52 Ford F4 Milk Truck; the guys unleash their best fabrication skills and turn this 60-year-old milk truck into a one of a kind, dazzling diesel street rod.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the guys take a good C10 to a hundred with custom touches from inside to out including one of one interior and bed; Ekstensive makes a dream come true by modifying a 2018 Dodge Demon for an under ten-second quarter mile run on the track.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: The wrecked shell of a 1970 Suburban car hauler tests Bill and his metal geniuses as they transform it into a high-end diesel, low, long bed, crew cab dually; Ekstensive makes a lifted and loaded F150 for Boots for Troops, a military charity.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill pushes the shop's creativity with his own build of a 2018 Yukon Denali XL; the luxury SUV is their tallest build ever with a custom lift, straight axles and a supercharger; the '70 Suburban gets a custom chassis and body with a fourth door.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the guys are known for their custom metal work, but the transformation of a 1940 International Harvester water truck into a mobile barbecue pit tests all their skills; a 1986 C-10 is a family heirloom that's remade for future generations.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the team try to outdo themselves with a radical redesign of 1950 Ford F5 COE, starting with a bed unlike any they've built; the shop begins its first shot at remaking a '69 Corvette Stingray.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: The team goes bigger on the yearlong 1950 Ford F5 COE build when the client asks for a last-minute Cummins diesel engine swap; a twisted graphic wraps up a months-long 2001 Ford F350.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the team fix another shop's mistakes when a 2017 F-350 is hauled into the shop broken due to a botched lift; a client insists on the ultimate tailgating BBQ trailer with custom everything.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill knows all too well that families are the lifeblood of the custom truck scene; a customer wants to transform a 1965 Ford Falcon Club Wagon into a fully custom family cruiser; a 1966 Cobra replica gets reinforced.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill looks to the year 2073 when the owner of a '73 El Camino challenges the shop to transform his vehicle into the Ride of the Future; the city wants a custom bumper on a 2020 Freightliner tow truck.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the team get their chance to finish a 1968 Chevy C10, which they turn into a unibody by welding the body and bed into one piece; an old dump truck rolls into the shop as the biggest truck the team has ever customized.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: A 1937 International Harvester gets a big old Cummins 12-valve diesel engine that's as heavy as the truck itself; a 2005 Chevy Colorado gets a new lease on life as a nitrous-infused drag truck.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: A 1996 dump truck is the largest truck the shop has ever customized; the guys go extra heavy duty to create a military-styled megatruck; a lowrider enthusiast wants a custom air ride and LS swap for his pristine 1934 Buick.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: This year's over-the-top build has Bill and crew lifting a 2020 Chevy Silverado 5500 more than a foot with a custom heavy-duty air suspension; the guys also prove their Texas mettle by radically overhauling the utility bed.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Hall of Fame running back Earl Campbell arrives with the body and parts of a 1949 Cadillac, and the crew is honored to create a ground-up build for the local legend; a 1940 F-100 build snowballs into a much bigger job.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: NFL Hall of Famer Earl Campbell made a career mowing down defenders, so the guys take the same hell-bent approach to rebuilding his 1949 Cadillac; they also customize a van for a disabled motocross rider so he can drive again.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: The team revamps an old school '34 Buick into a modern day lowrider; after months of rebuilding the body and making a custom frame for Earl Campbell's '49 Cadillac, the Hall of Famer challenges the shop with a last-minute wrinkle.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Every so often a visionary comes along, and with their imagination, grit and perseverance, they manage to fail and leave a mark on automotive history.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Rob Corddry and Emelia Hartford tell two stories of Japanese visionaries who managed to bring their visions to life and change the car world, despite obstacles.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Rule benders and sneaky geniuses: these are stories of creative risk-takers who know that sometimes you have to break the rules to be the hero.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: There are a million ways to modify a car, but few like these stories. From a manufacturer creating a narrow-use case spec, to one guy making a complete unicorn in his garage, we celebrate some forgotten oddballs of the mod world.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Certain men in the history of cars were just made from different stuff; these two drivers achieved insane feats against impossible odds to prove that they are legends among legends.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Taking a trip back in time to the early days of the automobile, when the first enterprising car enthusiasts laid the foundations for the car world today.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time
programme.desc: Some cars carry powerful myths with them long after they are gone; these are stories of cars whose intriguing legends have endured long past the metal they are made from.

programme.title: Super Turbo Story Time

programme.title: Live: SportsCenter
programme.desc: Las últimas noticias, momentos destacados e información de todos los rincones del mundo del deporte se presenta cada día en "SportsCenter", el primer programa de ESPN cuando la red se estrenó en septiembre de 1979. La serie se transmite en tres ediciones nocturnas, luego se re-transmite la última edición cuatro veces cada mañana de lunes a viernes antes de despejar el escenario para un bloque de seis horas de "SportsCenter" en vivo, que pone más énfasis en la interactividad de los fanáticos, noticias, análisis, comentarios y la cobertura de las conferencias de prensa.

programme.title: They Came to Cordura
programme.desc: On a mission to Mexico, U.S. Maj. Tom Thorn is branded a coward, while several of his fellow servicemen are praised for showing bravery. Tom is asked to transport the heroes through harsh terrain so they can be honored. Also along for the journey is Adelaide Geary, a woman charged with conspiring against the United States. But, as his fellow soldiers begin revealing their treacherous sides, Tom realizes that Adelaide is the only heroic one of the bunch.

programme.title: Relentless
programme.desc: Los Angeles police detectives (Robert Loggia, Leo Rossi) track the so-called Sunset Killer (Judd Nelson), who taunts them with messages.

programme.title: Dirty
programme.desc: Armando Sancho is a former Los Angeles gang member who has transitioned into law enforcement. Sancho, however, who is surrounded by corruption, finds that life as a police officer is just as morally bankrupt as life as a gangster. After being implicated in the shooting of an innocent man himself, Sancho is then pressured to testify against his loose-cannon friend and partner, Salim Adel, who has a history of abusing citizens.

programme.title: Linewatch
programme.desc: Border agent Michael Dixon's (Cuba Gooding Jr.) past as a gang member comes back to haunt him years later.

programme.title: Tears of the Sun
programme.desc: The Nigerian government has fallen, and the country is on the verge of civil war. Lt. A.K. Waters (Bruce Willis) has been assigned to lead a team of soldiers into the Nigerian jungle to rescue Dr. Lena Kendricks (Monica Bellucci). When Waters and his team locate Kendricks, she tells them she won't leave her helpless patients to be slaughtered by rebels. The team incurs the wrath of both U.S. and Nigerian forces when they side with Kendricks and attempt to march the refugees to safety.

programme.title: Hellcats of the Navy
programme.desc: Captain Casey Abbott (Ronald Reagan) commands an American submarine in the Pacific during World War II. When a perilous mission to retrieve a new Japanese mine for study goes awry, he's forced to abandon a likable combat diver, Wes Barton (Harry Lauter). Abbott's orders to leave a man behind appear to be justified, but his second in command, Don Landon (Arthur Franz), believes he had ulterior motives: Barton had been competing for the attention of his love interest, Helen (Nancy Davis).

programme.title: Limbo
programme.desc: After a traumatic accident years ago that left others dead, Joe Gastineau has lived a life full of guilt, leading a solitary existence as a fisherman in Alaska. After he meets lounge singer Donna, he starts to fall for her and open up. However, when Joe's half brother returns, asking for help, it sends Joe, Donna and her daughter, Noelle, on a boat ride that will change their lives.

programme.title: Black Hawk Down
programme.desc: In 1993, the U.S. sends special forces into Somalia to destabilize the government and bring food and humanitarian aid to the starving population. Using Black Hawk helicopters to lower the soldiers onto the ground, an unexpected attack by Somalian forces brings two of the helicopters down immediately. From there, the U.S. soldiers must struggle to regain their balance while enduring heavy gunfire.

programme.title: Basic
programme.desc: During special operations training mission in Panama, four U.S. soldiers are killed mysteriously, and their leader, Sgt. Nathan West, goes missing. A military investigator, Capt. Julia Osborne, has trouble convincing the two survivors to talk about what happened that night. A more experienced investigator, Tom Hardy, is brought in to crack the case. However, when the survivors do start talking, their stories differ from one another.

programme.title: The Guns of Navarone
programme.desc: In 1943, a small commando team is sent to destroy huge German guns on the Greek Island of Navarone in order to rescue Allied troops trapped on Kheros. Led by British Major Franklin (Anthony Quayle), the team includes American Mallory (Gregory Peck), Greek resistance fighter Stavros (Anthony Quinn) and reluctant explosives expert Miller. Facing impossible odds, the men battle stormy seas and daunting cliffs. When Franklin is injured, Mallory takes command, and personal enmities spill over.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa es una cerdita que vive con su hermanito George, su mamá y su papá. A ella le encanta jugar y saltar en los charcos de lodo. ¡Sus aventuras siempre terminan bien y con ronquidos de risa!

programme.title: Bebés llorones: lágrimas mágicas
programme.desc: Pequeños bebés con grandes personalidades exploran un mundo mágico donde sus lágrimas de amor y felicidad les conceden poderes especiales.

programme.title: El Show de Bely y Beto
programme.desc: Bely cuida de Beto y en cada edición trata de enseñarle cosas buenas y positivas de una manera divertida, mediante algunas lecciones que le mostraran lo elemental de la vida, con canciones, actividades e interesantes juegos.

programme.title: El reino de las rimas
programme.desc: Daisy y Cole guían a los niños por un mundo colorido y animado lleno de rimas y juegos imaginativos. Con música e imaginación, resuelven problemas en su ciudad, habitada por personajes de canciones infantiles.

programme.title: Masha y el oso
programme.desc: ¿Qué sucede cuando se encuentran una niñita increíblemente curiosa con un oso paciente y cariñoso que disfruta de una vida muy tranquila? ¡Una amistad repleta de maravillosas historias!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Son unas criaturas azules no mayores a un dedo índice, que viven en una aldea de hongos oculta en el bosque. Gargamel y su gato Azrael, intentarán atraparlos por ser un ingrediente necesario para obtener la piedra filosofal.

programme.title: Las aventuras del Gato con Botas
programme.desc: El héroe felino favorito del mundo, amante (y conocedor de la leche) se calza sus botas características y entra en acción cuando, sin querer, rompe el hechizo mágico que protege a la ciudad oculta de San Lorenzo.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: Lincoln Loud es un chico de once años que vive con sus diez hermanas. Con la ayuda de su confiable amigo Clyde, Lincoln encuentra nuevas y distintas maneras de sobrevivir a diario en una familia gigante.

programme.title: Prodigiosa: las aventuras de Ladybug
programme.desc: Marinette conoce al guardián de los Miraculous, y descubre la existencia de otros accesorios de poder y superhéroes que le pueden ser de ayuda en misiones particularmente difíciles.

programme.title: Bob Esponja
programme.desc: Cerca del Atolón Bikini, a algunas leguas bajo el mar, en una ciudad submarina llamada Fondo Bikini, vive Bob Esponja. No tiene un modo lógico de actuar en la vida, todo lo hace de una manera poco convencional.

programme.title: El Chavo animado
programme.desc: Chavo vive en una vecindad mexicana, junto a sus amigos Popis, Ñoño, Patty y Quico, y vivirá situaciones alocadas en cada episodio.

programme.title: Terror en la niebla
programme.desc: En 1871, durante una densa neblina en la costa de California, un naufragio hace que mueran cuatro delincuentes. Un siglo más tarde, los espíritus de estos marineros resurgen en busca de venganza.

programme.title: El cocodrilo vs. Anaconda
programme.desc: Dos peligrosas criaturas han escapado de un laboratorio y la comunidad cercana está a punto de vivir su peor pesadilla. Un cocodrilo y una anaconda sostendrán un brutal enfrentamiento, mientras acaban con todo lo que se cruza en su camino.

programme.title: El misterioso señor Marquina
programme.desc: Dos hermanos gemelos idénticos toman rumbos antagónicos para sus vidas. Uno de ellos se ha convertido en un criminal de carrera y es capaz de todo tipo de fechorías, mientras que el otro se opone a él y está decidido a detenerlo.

programme.title: Letras a fuego lento
programme.desc: El espacio ofrece una experiencia donde grandes novelas dialogan con platillos, traduciendo historias literarias en sabores y cocinando México con calma.

programme.title: Once noticias a las dos
programme.desc: El análisis de las noticias más destacadas de la jornada.

programme.title: A + A, Amor y Amistad
programme.desc: Programa que busca concienciar y sensibilizar sobre la responsabilidad que significa tener animales, su cuidado, alimentación, adiestramiento y todo lo necesario para mantenerlos sanos y felices.

programme.title: Los cuentos de Yetili
programme.desc: Nina y León, dos pequeños ratones, disfrutan de cuentos leídos por un Yeti cada día. Yetili, el peluche gigante y mascota de la librería, cobra vida por la noche y se une a sus amigos en emocionantes aventuras llenas de magia.

programme.title: Tweedy y Fluff
programme.desc: Tweedy pintar el retrato perfecto de Fluff, pero este no logra quedarse quieto, ¿podrá adaptarse?

programme.title: Tú decides la aventura
programme.desc: Una experiencia interactiva en la que los niños del público deciden de qué forma avanza la historia.

programme.title: Fútbol callejero
programme.desc: Todos los intentos del alcalde por detener la ola de fútbol callejero, ha fracasado. Pero manipulación hacia los padres de Eloise, en un intento de convencerlos de presentar una denuncia contra el propio Luis Ornando.

programme.title: Once noticias al minuto
programme.desc: Un informativo breve y actualizado que ofrece las noticias más relevantes del día, cubriendo política, sociedad y cultura, transmitidos a lo largo de la programación para mantener a la audiencia informada.

programme.title: Naturaleza espectacular
programme.desc: En Naturaleza Espectacular disfrutaremos de imágenes inolvidables que ocurren en México, como la migración de cientos de millones de mariposas, el viaje de 25 mil ballenas a través de nuestros hermosos mares etc.

programme.title: 31 minutos
programme.desc: Je Jin, un coleccionista de enfermedades, insiste en ser entrevistado para mostrar su exótico repertorio en el estudio. Cuando lo logra, todos se infectan con los males más extraños.

programme.title: Once noticias al minuto
programme.desc: Un informativo breve y actualizado que ofrece las noticias más relevantes del día, cubriendo política, sociedad y cultura, transmitidos a lo largo de la programación para mantener a la audiencia informada.

programme.title: Horizonte politécnico
programme.desc: Espacio institucional y cultural enfocado en difundir las actividades, la comunidad, la ciencia y el desarrollo del Instituto Politécnico Nacional.

programme.title: TAP: Taller de actores profesionales
programme.desc: En este espacio se sostienen reveladoras conversaciones con actores mexicanos, de distintos perfiles y generaciones, quienes hablan sobre sus experiencias en la industria del teatro y la televisión.

programme.title: Punto de referencia - Tu noticiero
programme.desc: Un espacio noticiosos que aborda los hechos más destacados de la agenda de noticias nacional. El espacio está conducido por los periodistas Azul Alzaga y Alberto Nájar y busca informar al público sobre los acontecimientos diarios.

programme.title: Masiosare
programme.desc: Un espacio de debate donde se discutirán los temas que más importan al país.

programme.title: Jazzero nacional
programme.desc: Serie documental y musical que busca visibilizar e impulsar el jazz contemporáneo hecho en México, priorizando obras y composiciones originales de artistas locales frente a los tradicionales conciertos de tributos.

programme.title: 27 bodas
programme.desc: Luego de ser madrina de bodas en veintisiete ocasiones, una joven se debate si realmente debería aceptar ser la madrina de su hermana, quien está a punto de casarse con el hombre que ella ama en secreto.

programme.title: La duquesa
programme.desc: Johanna deja atrás su vida en una finca municipal para empezar de nuevo en Londres. Allí cambiará su nombre y comenzará a trabajar como crítica musical.

programme.title: Negra Navidad
programme.desc: Un grupo de alumnas es acosado por un extraño durante sus vacaciones de Navidad. Eso es hasta que la joven hermandad de mujeres descubre que el asesino es parte de una conspiración clandestina de la universidad.

programme.title: Al otro lado del río y entre los árboles
programme.desc: Richard Cantwell es un coronel del ejército estadounidense atormentado por la guerra, que se enfrenta a la noticia de que padece una enfermedad terminal con estoica indiferencia.

programme.title: La noche que luché contra Dios
programme.desc: El 18 de julio de 1994, el joven Benjamín Sheinberg inicia su primer día como médico residente en el Hospital de Clínicas, en Buenos Aires, cuando, al mismo tiempo, una bomba explota en la AMIA causando la muerte de 85 personas.

programme.title: Nadando por el oro
programme.desc: Claire Carpenter se encuentra cara a cara con su rival Mikayla Michaels, y la noticia de que el campamento de natación se cerrará si su equipo pierde el próximo encuentro. Claire debe superar un miedo secreto y redescubrir su pasión.

programme.title: La increíble vida de Walter Mitty
programme.desc: Cuando su trabajo y el de su compañero se ven amenazados, Walter entra en acción en el mundo real y se embarca en un viaje alrededor del planeta, que se convierte en la aventura más extraordinaria que jamás podría haber imaginado.

programme.title: El callejón de las almas perdidas
programme.desc: Un ambicioso feriante muy hábil para manipular a través de la palabra se alía con una psiquiatra tan peligrosa como él y juntos estafan a la alta sociedad neoyorquina de los años 40.

programme.title: Harriet
programme.desc: Basada en la emocionante vida de un ícono de la lucha por la libertad, cuenta la historia extraordinaria del escape de Harriet Tubman de la esclavitud y su transformación en una de las heroínas más grandes de los EE.UU.

programme.title: ¡Mujeres al ataque!
programme.desc: Luego de descubrir que su novio está casado, Carly conoce a la esposa que él ha estado engañando. Pero cuando otro romance del muchacho sale a la luz, las dos, ahora, amigas se unirán a la tercera para vengarse.

programme.title: Moulin Rouge, amor en rojo
programme.desc: En el infame y llamativo centro nocturno parisino, el Moulin Rouge, Satine, su estrella y cortesana más famosa, se ve atrapada entre el amor de un escritor y la obsesión de otro hombre.

programme.title: Moulin Rouge, amor en rojo
programme.desc: En el infame y llamativo centro nocturno parisino, el Moulin Rouge, Satine, su estrella y cortesana más famosa, se ve atrapada entre el amor de un escritor y la obsesión de otro hombre.

programme.title: 30 noches con mi ex
programme.desc: El Turbo, luego de años de separado de su exmujer, acepta, por pedido de la hija que tienen en común, convivir durante treinta días con ella, quien viene de una larga internación psiquiátrica.

programme.title: Deportes CNN
programme.desc: Experimenta la acción y el dramatismo del mundo de los deportes más populares en la región: los titulares más recientes, las historias, las marcaciones, los resultados acompañados por entrevistas con los atletas, entrenadores y analistas.

programme.title: Perspectivas de México
programme.desc: Un programa que aborda los hechos más relevantes de la agenda de noticias de México. El periodista Mario González informa al público sobre los acontecimientos diarios más relevantes y construyue un análisis crítico de los mismos.

programme.title: Directo USA
programme.desc: Directo USA es su conexión directa a las noticias clave relacionadas con Estados Unidos. Desde la sede central de CNN en Atlanta, cubre los aspectos sobresalientes de las noticias en Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Panorama mundial
programme.desc: Un análisis profundo de la actualidad y de las noticias a nivel internacional, de la mano de diversos expertos.

programme.title: CNN Negocios con Gabi Frias

programme.title: Mexicánicos

programme.title: Mexicánicos
programme.desc: Martín Vaca llega a San Antonio, donde la frontera parece solo una línea en el mapa.

programme.title: Joyas sobre ruedas: por el mundo
programme.desc: Mike y Elvis se dirigen a Portugal, donde el icónico Mini Moke se convirtió en un auto de culto. Es un coche muy especial para Mike, pero los graves daños causados por el agua y la oxidación crónica hacen que sea una restauración completa.

programme.title: Joyas sobre ruedas

programme.title: Desafío x2
programme.desc: Dave y Cody demuestran cómo sobrevivir en las montañas Rocosas con los equipos remanentes de una víctima de avalancha. En temperaturas bajo cero descienden por una cascada congelada y construyen una caverna de nieve.

programme.title: A prueba de todo
programme.desc: En el sur del estado de Utah, Bear Grylls, armado de un lazo de vaquero, desciende una cumbre rocosa y queda preso en una garganta estrecha. Después, Bear acaba colgado sobre un barranco y hace una hazaña aérea increíble.

programme.title: Hombres del Ártico
programme.desc: Detectaron un lobo cerca de Tanana en las últimas semanas, y finalmente Charlie tiene la posibilidad de alcanzarlo de una vez y para siempre.

programme.title: Alaska: hombres primitivos
programme.desc: Luego de enfrentar obstáculos sin precedentes, los Brown reflexionan sobre el año que pasaron viviendo en las tierras agrestes de Alaska y hacen algunas revelaciones impactantes sobre el estilo de vida de la familia.

programme.title: Alaska: hombres primitivos
programme.desc: Los Brown quieren alejarse de la civilización después de haber pasado un tiempo en Ketchikan. Lograron encontrar un lote de tierra en el que están ansiosos por asentarse antes de que llegue el invierno, pero tienen algunas emergencias.

programme.title: Ed Stafford al extremo
programme.desc: Ed se enfrenta a una experiencia de supervivencia en el desierto de Atacama, el desierto más grande y seco del mundo.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo
programme.desc: Dos superfanáticos y críticos de Supervivencia al desnudo utilizan lo que aprendieron de supervivencia desde el sillón de su casa para intentar aguantar 14 días en las selvas de Colombia.

programme.title: Supervivencia al desnudo: el último en pie
programme.desc: Una lesión en la pierna pone en peligro el desafío de Matt. Durante una peligrosa migración de aguas bravas, los sobrevivientes y sus balsas son golpeadas. Además, nuevas dinámicas de campamento sacuden la competencia.

programme.title: Ed Stafford: rituales del mundo
programme.desc: Ed conoce a los hamer, unos ganaderos etíopes, quienes tienen el ritual de saltar una fila de toros, para ser considerados hombres. Luego, él deberá domar a estos enormes animales, para saltar sobre ellos.

programme.title: Reino de la sabana
programme.desc: Leopard Olimba encuentra pareja, pero la suerte se vuelve en contra de los leones. Las inundaciones extremas provocan un desastre para el clan de las hienas, y ha llegado el momento de que el leopardo Mutima se vaya.

programme.title: Planeta Tierra II
programme.desc: Los leopardos merodean por las calles de Bombay, los halcones peregrinos cazan por los rascacielos de Nueva York y millones de estorninos vuelan por Roma. En Jodhpur consideran divinos a los langures,

programme.title: Mexicánicos
programme.sub-title: De F150 a Limo Carroza Raptor
programme.desc: Rafael y Karina, los dueños de una empresa funeraria de Morelia, llegan buscando llevar a su negocio a un nivel superior. Quieren tener una carroza que no existe en el mercado, algo novedoso para ofrecer a sus clientes más especiales.

programme.title: Mexicánicos
programme.sub-title: Chevrolet Colorado OLX - Sultantes de Monterrey
programme.desc: Para celebrar el patrocinio a los Sultanes de Monterrey, el equipo de béisbol más importante del país, se sortea un auto entre sus fanáticos.

programme.title: Estómagos de hierro
programme.desc: El cazador neozelandés Josh James y el chef británico Matt Tebbutt viajan a las Barrancas del Cobre, en el noroeste de México. Abandonados en esta zona aislada, deberán demostrar que pueden vencer a la naturaleza casi sin equipamiento.

programme.title: Estómagos de hierro
programme.desc: El cazador neozelandés Josh James y el chef británico Matt Tebbutt son abandonados por un helicóptero en los montes Ródope de Bulgaria, en el sur de Europa. Deberán sobrevivir sin ayuda en uno de los bosques más antiguos.

programme.title: Legado salvaje
programme.desc: La crianza en el océano es poco común y exige dedicación e inteligencia. Desde navegar por el arrecife hasta enseñar a sus crías a cazar gigantes, estos padres poseen las estrategias más extraordinarias del planeta.

programme.title: Dinastías
programme.desc: La historia de una joven reina suricata, que vive en la implacable belleza de las salinas de Makgadikgadi. Para que sus nuevas crías sobrevivan, deberá unir a su familia frente a rivales, depredadores y enormes tormentas de polvo.

programme.title: Dinastías
programme.desc: La historia de una joven reina suricata, que vive en la implacable belleza de las salinas de Makgadikgadi. Para que sus nuevas crías sobrevivan, deberá unir a su familia frente a rivales, depredadores y enormes tormentas de polvo.

programme.title: Planeta azul II
programme.desc: El océano abierto es como un gran desierto marítimo. Para sobrevivir, los animales llegan al extremo con características épicas de resistencia e inteligencia.

programme.title: Eye of the Storm
programme.desc: Cuando un tornado azota Texas y Kansas en 2022, cientos de testigos se encuentran atrapados en el camino. Pero mientras buscan el mejor refugio que pueden encontrar, capturan los momentos en que los tornados destruyen las estructuras.

programme.title: En medio del desastre
programme.sub-title: Escapando de los incendios en Los Ángeles
programme.desc: En enero de 2025, incendios provocados por el viento arrasan Los Ángeles. Cámaras captan el caos y la valentía de residentes que huyen y salvan a sus seres queridos, mientras la ciudad enfrenta uno de los peores incendios de su historia.

programme.title: Solo y en peligro
programme.desc: En las montañas de Montana, el ingeniero Todd Orr es atacado dos veces por una osa que protege a sus crías. Y durante unas vacaciones en Bahamas, Tiffany Johnson se encuentra con un tiburón tigre.

programme.title: Barbie
programme.desc: Barbie vive en Barbieland donde todo es ideal y lleno de música y color. Sin embargo, cuando comienza a plantearse cuestiones incómodas, decide conocer el mundo real. El CEO de Mattel hará todo lo posible para impedirlo.

programme.title: Ciudad de Dios - La lucha no para
programme.desc: Mientras Touro aterroriza a los habitantes y desafía a Jerusa, Berenice denuncia la corrupción en Gardênia Azul con un contundente discurso. Leka descubre a un artista prometedor entre los hombres de Geninho.

programme.title: El final de la Calle Oak
programme.desc: La familia Platt se une para desenvolverse en su nuevo entorno después de que un evento cósmico traslada su barrio residencial a un lugar desconocido.

programme.title: El plan del asesino
programme.desc: Un asesino a sueldo llamado John Knox sufre una forma de demencia que evoluciona rápidamente y se le ofrece la oportunidad de redimirse salvando la vida del hijo adulto con el que estaba distanciado.

programme.title: Mother Mary
programme.desc: Las heridas enterradas hace mucho tiempo salen a la superficie cuando la icónica estrella del pop Madre María se reúne con su distanciada mejor amiga y ex diseñador de vestuario, Sam Anselm, en vísperas de su actuación de regreso.

programme.title: En primera plana
programme.desc: Descubre cómo un equipo de reporteros logró destapar varios escándalos de pederastia que fueron cometidos durante décadas por unos curas en Massachussets y ocultados durante mucho tiempo por la arquidiócesis de Boston.

programme.title: Rey marfil
programme.desc: Para Layne West, agente de la unidad antinarcóticos de Tulsa, la lucha contra la delincuencia local es parte de su rutina diaria. Sin embargo, el problema le toca muy de cerca cuando su hijo, Jack cae en la adicción al fentanilo.

programme.title: El pez pucheros
programme.desc: Cuando se produce una catástrofe, el huraño y susceptible Pez Pucheros y su hiperactivo compañero, el dragón marino Pip, deben embarcarse en una aventura en busca de un pez mítico que les conceda el deseo de salvar sus hogares.

programme.title: Aquaman
programme.desc: Cuenta la historia del origen de Arthur Curry, mitad humano y mitad atlante, quien emprende la aventura de su vida; una que lo obligará a enfrentarse a quien realmente es y también lo ayudará a descubrir si es merecedero del trono.

programme.title: Ciudad de Dios - La lucha no para

programme.title: Exterminio: El templo de huesos
programme.desc: Un mensajero en bicicleta despierta de un coma para descubrir que el mundo ha sido invadido por zombis tras el brote de un virus.

programme.title: Evil Dead: en llamas
programme.desc: Tras la pérdida de su esposo, una mujer busca consuelo con sus suegros en su aislada casa familiar. A medida que uno a uno se transforman en Deadites, descubre que los votos que hizo en vida perduran incluso en la muerte.

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Kong
programme.desc: En un momento en que los monstruos caminan por la Tierra, la lucha de la humanidad por su futuro pone a Godzilla y Kong en un curso de colisión que verá a las dos fuerzas más poderosas del planeta chocar en una batalla espectacular.

programme.title: Guerra
programme.desc: Tras una impactante revelación que lleva a los Cathcarts y a Taylor & Byrne a culparse mutuamente por la filtración, Carla testifica que ella y sus amigos famosos fueron fundamentales para el éxito inicial de Zephyr.

programme.title: Diamante de sangre
programme.desc: En medio de la guerra civil de Sierra Leona, se cruzan las historia de Danny Archer, un ex mercenario, y Solomon Vandy, un pescador de Mende. Ambos hombres son africanos, pero sus historias y sus circunstancias son completamente diferentes.

programme.title: El camino de regreso
programme.desc: Una ex estrella del baloncesto juvenil, en medio de un momento difícil en el que padece problemas de adicción, comienza a entrenar a un equipo mediocre de instituto. ¿Será esto suficiente para recomponer su vida?

programme.title: Until Dawn: noche de terror
programme.desc: Un grupo pasa el fin de semana en un refugio de esquí. Se reúnen por el aniversario de la desaparición de sus amigos, sin saber que no están solos. Extrañas presencias los acompañarán en esta conmemoración.

programme.title: Los fantasmas de mis ex
programme.desc: Connor es un mujeriego absoluto. En la boda de su hermano, el fantasma de su tío le dice que lo visitarán tres espectros que lo guiarán a través de su pasado, presente y futuro amoroso. ¿Logrará Connor a cambiar y amar a la mujer indicada?

programme.title: Superman
programme.desc: En un mundo cínico que ha perdido la fe en la bondad, Superman lucha por reconciliar su herencia kryptoniana con su crianza humana en Smallville como Clark Kent.

programme.title: Black Adam
programme.desc: Black Adam es liberado de su tumba casi cinco mil años después de haber sido encarcelado y recibir sus poderes de los antiguos dioses. Ahora está listo para desatar su forma única de justicia en el mundo.

programme.title: Harry Potter y el cáliz de fuego
programme.desc: En su cuarto año de estudios en Hogwarts, Harry vivirá muchas aventuras. Deberá competir en un peligroso torneo, y también tendrá que enfrentar a su némesis, el malvado Lord Voldemort, quien quiere acabar con Harry de una vez por todas.

programme.desc: Agnes intenta recuperar el control de la cena presidencial, la carrera de Peggy provoca una ruptura con William y Ada se encuentra con el Dr. Harris.

programme.title: La hora de la desaparición

programme.desc: Como Luis le ha preparado el desayuno, ahora Silvita se encargará de prepararle un platillo espectacular. ¿Se atreverá a decirle que no tiene buen sazón? Y mira en que ocupará Frankie la computadora que Lorena le consiguió para trabajar.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: Al vecindario llega un hojalatero, quien pondrá su taller en la calle. ¿Crees que alguno de los vecinos tenga el valor para quitarlo de ahí? Y mira a Cris motivando a Pedro para que limpie el departamento por primera vez.

programme.title: Vecinos
programme.desc: Germán le entrega a Vanessa cosas que le dejó don Roque, por lo que ambos lo recuerdan y homenajean. Lorena aprecia a Soledad, la nueva amiga de Benito.

programme.title: La momia

programme.title: Spider-Man: Sin camino a casa

programme.title: El tren navideño de las sorpresas
programme.desc: Un periodista se embarca en un viaje en tren de travesía en Navidad sin tener idea de que este viaje lo llevará al terreno accidentado de su propio corazón.

programme.desc: Sydney es una azafata a quien le asignan cuidar a Leah, una menor que viaja sola. Luego de que es entregada a su padre, Sydney encuentra un paquete que Leah dejó olvidado y se lo lleva. Al hacerlo, el padre la invita a pasar las fiestas.

programme.title: Navidad en el lago
programme.desc: La diseñadora de interiores Reilly se encuentra en la ciudad de Mistletoe Lake sin un lugar donde quedarse en Navidad. Ella acepta una oferta de Ray para quedarse en su bote y lo ayuda a renovarlo para el festival naivdeño de la ciudad.

programme.title: La estrella de Navidad
programme.desc: Tras vivir un escándalo, una famosa se dirige a un lujoso resort de Vermont para pasar la Navidad. Al llegar, un error en la reserva la lleva a un pintoresco B&B propiedad de un profesor de astronomía.

programme.title: Christmas in Vienna
programme.desc: Jess, una concertista de violín que ha perdido su pasión, visita Viena en Navidad. Allí encuentra la inspiración que le faltaba, junto a un diplomático estadounidense y sus hijos.

programme.title: Holiday Mismatch
programme.desc: Barb, recién jubilada, se une a un comité navideño, pero choca con Kath, una integrante de larga trayectoria. Cuando se dan cuenta de que sus hijos han empezado a salir, conspiran para romper a la feliz pareja.

programme.title: El último de su especie

programme.title: El acuario

programme.title: Guaridas con estilo

programme.title: Mascotas revoltosas

programme.title: La guerra aérea
programme.desc: Siente el temor y la aceleración de la batalla a 30.000 pies de altura. Sigues las huellas del aclamado especial de 2 horas, sobre las Películas Perdidas de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: The Secret History of World War II
programme.desc: Detrás de la Batalla de Inglaterra hay muchas historias, entre ellas la del piloto Bill Millington, que se sacrificó para salvar a civiles, y la de un medallista de oro olímpico estadounidense que voló para la RAF.

programme.title: Boys Toys
programme.desc: Descubra el mejor simulador de carreras del mundo. Luego, un carro de golf que sabe redefinir el lujo. También te mostramos una bicicleta estática, que te conduce alrededor del mundo.

programme.title: Demonios de Hollywood

programme.title: Crímenes de las chicas pesadas
programme.desc: Perry, Nueva York, 2016. En la fábrica de galletas, amistades y rivalidades crecen rápido. Lo que empieza como chismes inofensivos se torna amargo, y cuando celos y ambición se desbordan, la dulce vida termina en asesinato a sangre fría.

programme.title: Crímenes de las chicas pesadas
programme.desc: En un pequeño pueblo del Medio Oeste, tres mujeres unidas por la Wicca y la brujería se enfrentan al terror, cuando una de ellas cree que una bruja poderosa las maldijo.

programme.title: Cuando el mal se disfraza
programme.desc: Daniel Halseth, un padre divorciado, vive para las visitas con sus hijos. Cuando su hija Sierra afirma que quiere vivir con su padre, Daniel se ve envuelto en una red de mentiras y un complot que termina con un incendio mortal en su casa.

programme.title: Mujeres perdidas de Alaska

programme.title: Mujeres perdidas de Alaska
programme.desc: Un año después de dejarlo escapar, la policía busca a un asesino. Lo encuentran, pero el video del crimen en su teléfono revela que es solo el inicio de algo mucho más oscuro.

programme.title: Mujeres perdidas de Alaska

programme.title: Víctimas del amor

programme.title: Casados con secretos

programme.title: 911: ¿Llamó el asesino?

programme.title: Across the River and Into the Trees
programme.desc: Richard Cantwell es un coronel del ejército estadounidense, atormentado por la guerra, que se enfrenta a la noticia de que padece una enfermedad terminal con estoica indiferencia. Un encuentro casual con una joven revive en él la esperanza.

programme.title: La noche que luché contra Dios
programme.desc: Benjamín Sheinberg viaja a Israel y conoce la historia del patriarca bíblico Jacob, con el que encuentra una fuerte conexión.

programme.title: Nadando por el oro
programme.desc: Envían a la joven y experimentada nadadora Claire a Australia para entrenar a un equipo de natación masculino, donde debe superar a un viejo rival, vencer un miedo secreto y evitar que el centro de natación cierre.

programme.title: La increíble vida de Walter Mitty
programme.desc: Walter Mitty, editor fotográfico de la revista Life, evita el aburrimiento cotidiano con aventuras imaginarias, pero una misteriosa mujer lo hará vivir algo real.

programme.title: El callejón de las almas perdidas
programme.desc: En la Nueva York de la década de 1940, el estafador Stanton Carlisle se une a una vidente y el esposo de esta, un mentalista, para robarle a un peligroso millonario. El grupo recibe la ayuda de una misteriosa psiquiatra que tiene su propio plan.

programme.title: Harriet
programme.desc: La historia de Harriet Tubman, quien dirigió valientes misiones para llevar a los esclavos a la libertad, tras haber escapado ella misma en 1849.

programme.title: Mujeres al ataque
programme.desc: Tres mujeres unen fuerzas para vengarse de un hombre canalla, mentiroso e infiel que las traicionó a todas.

programme.title: Moulin Rouge, amor en rojo
programme.desc: Satine, la estrella más rutilante del Moulin Rouge, encandila a toda la ciudad con sus bailes llenos de sensualidad. Atrapada entre el amor de dos hombres, un joven escritor y un duque, mientras lucha por hacer realidad su sueño de ser actriz.

programme.title: 30 noches con mi ex
programme.desc: El Turbo, luego de años de separado de La Loba, acepta por pedido de la hija que tienen en común, convivir durante treinta días con su exmujer, que viene de una larga internación psiquiátrica.

programme.title: Queen y Slim: Los fugitivos
programme.desc: La primera cita de Slim y Queen toma un rumbo inesperado tras ser detenidos por la policía sin ningún motivo aparente. La pareja se da a la fuga tras dispararle al agente en defensa propia.

programme.title: La gran aventura de los Lunnis y el libro mágico
programme.desc: La fantasía está en peligro. El malvado Crudo ha descubierto la forma de terminar con el Libro Mágico, que contiene todas las historias inventadas por la humanidad. Una niña de 9 años es la elegida para salvarla con la ayuda de sus amigos los Lunnis.

programme.title: Yo, traidor
programme.desc: Un joven empresario trata de fundar una compañía pesquera en un remoto pueblo de la Patagonia, en Argentina, lo cual lo lleva a un doble conflicto con su familia y con los pescadores locales.

programme.title: Pelotas en juego
programme.desc: El dueño de un gimnasio y un empresario prepotente forman equipos de balón prisionero para competir por $50,000 dólares en Las Vegas.

programme.title: Hoy se arregla el mundo
programme.desc: David, productor de televisión, descubre que no es el padre de su hijo de 9 años, Benito, a quien está muy unido. No obstante, le promete al pequeño que encontrará a su verdadero padre y, juntos, se embarcan en una aventura inolvidable.

programme.title: The Way I See It
programme.desc: Un fotógrafo captura momentos históricos e íntimos del expresidente Barack Obama y del expresidente Ronald Reagan.

programme.title: Ophelia
programme.desc: Ofelia forma parte de las personas de confianza de la reina Gertrudis y su personalidad logra conquistar rápidamente al príncipe Hamlet. Después del asesinato del rey, Ofelia deberá contener a las altas esferas del poder danés.

programme.title: No soy tu mami
programme.desc: Paula, una periodista que integra una revista, decide escribir sobre maternidad para aumentar las ventas y salvar el proyecto. Ella expresa y fundamenta por qué no desea ser madre, pero los resultados no son los esperados.

programme.title: 30 noches con mi ex
programme.desc: El Turbo, luego de años de separado de La Loba, acepta por pedido de la hija que tienen en común, convivir durante treinta días con su exmujer, que viene de una larga internación psiquiátrica.

programme.title: Blancanieves y el cazador
programme.desc: Un cazador es enviado por una reina malvada a que capture a una princesa fugitiva, pero el hombre se convierte en su protector y la ayuda en su búsqueda para recuperar el control del reino.

programme.title: La cacería
programme.desc: Doce desconocidos despiertan en el claro de un bosque. No se conocen, pero tienen algo en común: un grupo de millonarios los ha elegido para divertirse cazándolos como si fueran animales salvajes. No obstante, algunos venderán cara su piel.

programme.title: Algo azul
programme.desc: Óscar y Eli han son mejores amigos, pero en la noche previa a la boda del hermano de Óscar se emborrachan y tienen relaciones sexuales. En eso descubren que destrozaron el vestido de la novia y deben de encontrar la manera de reponerlo.

programme.title: Alerta aeropuerto
programme.desc: Tres extranjeros intentan dejar el país con documentos falsos; un pasajero que lleva cocaína asegura haber sido engañado; un vuelo con ciudadanos deportados de los Estados Unidos alerta a la seguridad.
